facts.reason: These pages teach art topics and include numbered classroom activities, questions, materials, and step-by-step instructions.
Several shown pages have reader tasks such as numbered questions, prompts to discuss, and making activities, though the sample does not prove most pages do.
On all shown pages, the text is in separate blocks above, below, or beside the pictures rather than printed over the images.
The shown pages contain photos and artwork reproductions with captions and instructions, but no maps, charts, or labelled explanatory diagrams.
